title: Adding support for filtering pit requests by index and shard

timeline.message: Adding support for filtering pit requests by index and shard
timeline.author: Keith Massey

timeline.body:
This makes it so that you can have a PIT query only search given indices and shards, bringing it to parity with what scrolls support.
I'm marking this as draft because I'm not familiar with this code, and not sure if the search team even wants this feature.
Closes #85703
Relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch-hadoop/issues/1925

timeline.body: This PR is currently failing to pass all tests because data streams don't work the way I've done it. Adding data stream support to the REST path seems straightforward enough, but EQL is using a different path than I've been testing with (TransportOpenPointInTimeAction), and that seems a lot harder to fix.

timeline.author: Keith Massey

timeline.body: We don't want to merge this. This is just to get everything working with data streams.

This PR works well for testing es-hadoop use of PITs, but I'm going to close it because it's not really close to ready. Here's my known to do list (there might be more)

1. Properly support datastreams (as opposed to the hack I did in TransportSearchAction).
2. Add support for all `preference` values (currently only supports `_shards`).
3. Fix all the tests that are currently braking.
